scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n HOME,ORGAN,NEURO_UI,NEURO_API,CHAIN "npm run dev" "npm run dev:organ" "npm run dev:neuro-ui" "npm run dev:neuro" "npm run dev:chain"
scripts.check:server: node --check server/index.js && node --check server/osmDoctors.js && node --check server/providerResponse.js
scripts.dev:neuro: cd modules/neuro && NEURO_API_ONLY=true node --env-file-if-exists=../../.env --import tsx server.ts
scripts.setup:all: npm install && npm install --prefix modules/organ && npm install --prefix modules/neuro && npm install --prefix modules/blockchain
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build --prefix modules/organ && npm run build --prefix modules/neuro
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -k -n HOME,REPORTS,ORGAN,NEURO "npm run dev" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:organ" "npm run dev:neuro"
